prepare.shaders_failed: Preparing the shaders failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
cleanup.romfs_unreadable: The game data in {path} is missing or cannot be read after the install. Restart Windows, then run the installer again on the same folder: it extracts the game data again and keeps the rest.
prepare.pack_failed: Packing the shader cache failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
warn.lang_needs_fonts: Text in {lang} needs the Switch system fonts, which the installer does not extract; some text may not show.
warn.npdm_differs: main.npdm differs from the reference {version} dump; only the code modules are used.
warn.dkb_libraries_failed: The shaders are translated, but building the graphics driver's pipeline libraries crashed (exit code {code}), a driver problem seen on NVIDIA 621.01. The game continues without them and may stutter, and it may hit the same driver problem when it first needs a shader. Details: {log}
warn.dkb_pack_failed: The shaders are translated, but folding the shader cache into one file failed (exit code {code}). The game works with the loose files, but copying or deleting the folder stays slow. Details: {log}
warn.xbox_prompts_failed: The Xbox button prompts could not be prepared (exit code {code}); the game keeps the Switch prompts. Details: {log}
warn.low_commit_limit: Windows can commit only {commit} GB of memory (RAM plus page file), and the game needs about 14 GB on top of what the system and other programs use; below {need} GB it may freeze or crash. To fix this, enlarge the page file: Settings, System, About, Advanced system settings, Advanced tab, Performance Settings, Advanced tab, Virtual memory, Change, then pick a custom size or let Windows manage it, and restart.
warn.kernel_old: Linux {version} lacks the write tracking the game relies on (6.7 or later); the game may run very slowly. Updating the system fixes this.

dkb.ui.intro: Builds Donkey Kong Bananza 1.0.0 or 3.2.0 from your own dump: a .nup file, or ExeFS and RomFS folders. With a .nup that also holds the 3.2.0 update, setup builds 3.2.0.
dkb.ui.package: Tool package (optional: the release already holds it)
dkb.ui.pick_exefs: Choose the 1.0.0 or 3.2.0 ExeFS folder containing main and sdk
dkb.ui.pick_romfs: Choose the loose or packed RomFS folder
dkb.ui.pick_package: Choose the tool package with llvm, runtime/deps and bin folders
dkb.ui.pick_nup: Choose the game's .nup file (or leave it empty and choose the ExeFS and RomFS folders)
dkb.ui.update_mode: This folder holds a Bananza installation. Setup verifies the recorded source folders and continues from the last completed step.
dkb.need_exefs: Choose a .nup file, or the ExeFS folder of 1.0.0 or 3.2.0.
dkb.need_package: Choose an existing tool package folder.
dkb.need_folders: Choose a .nup file, or existing ExeFS and RomFS folders of Bananza 1.0.0 or 3.2.0.
dkb.exefs_invalid: {path} does not match Bananza 1.0.0 or 3.2.0. Setup has not changed the destination.
dkb.update_unsupported: This Bananza installer takes a .nup file or ExeFS and RomFS folders of 1.0.0 or 3.2.0. It does not read NSP or XCI files or keys, and ExeFS folders with subsdk modules are not supported.
dkb.path_link: Setup cannot use a symbolic link or junction: {path}.
dkb.path_overlap: The output and source folders must be separate: {path} and {other}.
dkb.dest_unrelated: Choose an empty destination or a folder already owned by this Bananza installer: {path}.
dkb.clean_nothing: There are no build files to delete: {path} does not exist.
dkb.temp_unrelated: The temporary folder contains unrelated files: {path}. Choose another temporary location.
dkb.temp_unsafe_path: The work folder {path} has characters (such as parentheses) that the shader translator build cannot pass to the linker. Move the release folder, or pass --temp with a path made of letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores.
dkb.romfs_empty: No RomFS files were found in {path}.
dkb.romfs_image: The folder {path} holds a RomFS image, not extracted RomFS files. Select the .nup package instead, or extract the RomFS as a folder.
dkb.in_place_folder: Using the RomFS where it is needs an extracted RomFS folder of loose files; {path} is a .nup or a packed RomFS image. Leave the option off, or choose the extracted folder.
dkb.ui.romfs_in_place: Use the RomFS where it is (no 9 GB copy in the install folder; the RomFS folder must then stay where it is)
dkb.input_changed: The source changed while setup was reading it: {path}. Close programs modifying the dump and try again.
dkb.pack_invalid: The packed RomFS failed its integrity check in {path}: {detail}.
dkb.tools_missing: Required build tools or sources are missing: {paths}.
dkb.dlls_missing: The runtime DLL folder {path} is missing {files}. Choose the tool package or pass --dll-dir.
dkb.translator_mismatch: The translator is missing its matching identity or was built from different sources. Build it from this checkout or let setup build it with .NET 10.
dkb.dotnet_missing: Building the translator needs the .NET 10 SDK. Pass --dotnet to a portable SDK, or --translator to a matching prebuilt translator.
dkb.jobs: The worker limit must be at least 1.
dkb.temp_space: The temporary folder {path} has a space in its path, and so does the system temporary folder, which breaks the .NET native build. Pass --temp with a path that has no spaces.
dkb.busy: Another setup is already using {path}. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
dkb.space: The install folder {path} needs about {need} GiB free on its disk, with the temporary build files when they share it; {free} GiB is free.
dkb.temp_disk_space: The temporary folder {path} needs about {need} GiB free on its disk; {free} GiB is free. It sits in the setup folder, not the install folder: move the whole setup folder to a disk with room, or pass --temp with a folder on one.
dkb.tool_failed: The {step} step failed with exit code {code}. Details: {log}.
dkb.elevation_required: Windows asked for administrator rights to start {exe}. Right-click it, choose Properties, Compatibility, and clear "Run this program as an administrator" (also under "Change settings for all users"). Check that your antivirus did not touch it, or run the setup once as administrator. Then run the setup again; it resumes.
dkb.patches_missing: The generated code lacks the required Bananza patch table. Setup stopped before compiling.
dkb.nup_and_folders: Choose either a .nup file or ExeFS and RomFS folders, not both.
dkb.nup_invalid: {path} cannot be used as a .nup container: {detail}.
dkb.nup_version: {path} holds Bananza {version} (title version {title_version}), which this setup does not support. Supported: 1.0.0 and 3.2.0. To build the base 1.0.0 from the same file, run the command-line setup with --nup-package base.
dkb.nup_zstd: {path} stores files compressed with zstd, and the Python that runs setup cannot decompress them. Use Python 3.14, install the zstandard package, or put a zstd program on PATH.

phase.dkb_fsr4.dkb_fetch: Downloading AMD FSR 4 from AMD's FidelityFX SDK repository
warn.dkb_fsr4_failed: AMD FSR 4 could not be downloaded ({file}: {detail}); setup will continue and the game uses FSR 3.1. Rerun setup to try again.
warn.dkb_fsr4_new_release: This setup fetches AMD FSR 4 from FidelityFX SDK {release}, whose license you have not accepted yet: tick AMD FSR 4 again to read and accept it.
dkb.ui.fsr4: Download AMD FSR 4 from AMD (about 35 MB, for the fsr4 upscaler on Radeon RX 6000 and newer)
dkb.ui.fsr4_intro: AMD FSR 4 comes only as AMD's signed libraries, which this project does not ship. Setup downloads amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll and amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll of FidelityFX SDK {release} from AMD's repository on GitHub, checks them against known hashes, and puts them next to dkb.exe with this license. Read AMD's license below; the download happens only if you accept it.
dkb.ui.fsr4_loading: Fetching the license from AMD's repository...
dkb.ui.fsr4_fetch_failed: AMD's license could not be fetched ({detail}). Check the connection and try again; you can read it at {url}.
phase.dkb_dlss.dkb_fetch: Downloading NVIDIA DLSS from NVIDIA's DLSS repository
warn.dkb_dlss_failed: NVIDIA DLSS could not be downloaded ({file}: {detail}); setup will continue without it. Rerun setup to try again.
warn.dkb_dlss_new_release: This setup fetches NVIDIA DLSS {release}, whose license you have not accepted yet: tick NVIDIA DLSS again to read and accept it.
dkb.ui.dlss: Download NVIDIA DLSS from NVIDIA (about 63 MB, for the dlss upscaler and DLSS Frame Generation; NVIDIA RTX only)
dkb.ui.dlss_intro: DLSS comes only as NVIDIA's own library, which this project does not ship. Setup downloads nvngx_dlss.dll and nvngx_dlssg.dll (DLSS Frame Generation) of DLSS release {release} from NVIDIA's repository on GitHub, checks them against known hashes, and puts them next to dkb.exe with this license. DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU. Read NVIDIA's license below; the download happens only if you accept it.
dkb.ui.dlss_loading: Fetching the license from NVIDIA's repository...
dkb.ui.dlss_fetch_failed: NVIDIA's license could not be fetched ({detail}). Check the connection and try again; you can read it at {url}.
